note: Authoritative build manifest for The Glade. Each mod has a resolved, verified `url`, `source` (modrinth|curseforge), and hashes (Modrinth gives sha512; CurseForge pins on sha1). Two build sets derive from `side` (see .sides): client = all mods; server = side!=client. `side` here is the DISTRIBUTION decision (curated), not merely Modrinth’s declared env: e.g. Athena is a client-rendering lib but is marked `both` because Chipped hard-depends on it server-side; DistantHorizons/Oculus/Embeddium/MouseTweaks/3D-Skin-Layers are `client` (pure client, no server role); JEI is `both` (kept server-side for recipe sync). PINS: Icarus is deliberately held at 2.13.2 (2.14.0 exists — do not “fix” it on a routine bump). Forge 47.4.10 is a hard FLOOR: Fish 'N' Ships and Hybrid Blocks require [47.4.10,). Geckolib is pinned from both sides by Aquamirae (>=4.8.0) and Devourer of Gods ([4.8,5.0)); PAUCAL is pinned by Hexal/MoreIotas to [0.6.0,0.7.0). The Sophisticated Core/Backpacks/CreateIntegration trio must always move together. Modrinth URLs come from the v2 version_files bulk sha1 lookup; CurseForge URLs are the forgecdn path files/{fileId div 1000}/{fileId mod 1000}/{filename} (percent-encode filename metachars, e.g. [ ] as %5B %5D).
